entities.summary: Fred Fortin is a Canadian rock singer-songwriter. Formerly associated with the bands Galaxie, Gros Mené and Les Breastfeeders, he has also released several solo albums. His 2009 album Plastrer la lune was a longlisted nominee for the 2010 Polaris Music Prize. Fred Fortin was a composers & musicians from Dolbeau-Mistassini (b. 1971-05-15, Dolbeau-Mistassini). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
